messages.en: Please hide that gift in the bedroom for now, okay? Aina's here already!
Done, I've put it in the wardrobe. She didn't see a thing.

senses.en_definition: Lasting for a limited time; temporary.
During the time that; while a condition still holds or before something happens.
While; at the same time as, or whereas when contrasting two situations.
Meanwhile; at that time or, when introducing a separate development, in the meantime.

collocations.en: while also carrying out one's duties

messages.en: Faiz said he's running a bit late. Shall we wait till he gets here before we order?
Let's order some drinks first while we wait for him. I'm thirsty already.
Sure, we can all order food together when he gets here.
How long are you going back to your hometown for?
Just a week. I've got to be back at work next Monday.

senses.en_definition: May; used to express a hope or wish for a favourable outcome.

messages.en: My interview's at nine tomorrow. I'm so nervous—I'm scared I won't know what to say.
Good luck tomorrow! You've prepared, right? Get some rest and don't overthink it.
